title: Pixel-art lava flow with glowing cracks
purpose: Generate a tileable pixel-art lava tile at a chosen art resolution: dark crust plates with lit and shadowed edges over glowing cracks with a pale core, or crust islands in a bubbling lava lake, with an emissive map and per-pixel normal, height, roughness and occlusion maps. Use for volcanic 2D game levels.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python pixel_lava_flow.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: art_pixels
parameters.meaning: Art pixels along each side of the tile; the maps enlarge them with nearest-neighbour sampling.

parameters.name: crack_width
parameters.meaning: Half width of the molten cracks in art pixels.

parameters.name: crust
parameters.meaning: Plate size: 1 fills the cells up to the cracks, lower values leave islands in a lava lake.

parameters.name: bubbles
parameters.meaning: Density of bubbles in wide molten areas.

parameters.name: relief
parameters.meaning: Strength of the per-pixel normal map.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo and the glow in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Black basalt plates over bright orange cracks.

presets.name: cooling
presets.description: Grey cooling crust with thin dull-red cracks.

presets.name: lava_lake
presets.description: A bubbling orange lake with small floating crust islands.

presets.name: toxic_magma
presets.description: Fantasy green-yellow magma under violet crust.

limits: A still frame of stylized pixel art, not a flow simulation, and it does not animate; for motion, cycle seeds or shift the emissive strength. The glow is a fixed three-step colour scale of distance to the plate border, not a temperature model, and the albedo also holds the glowing colours so the tile reads without lighting. Plates are Voronoi cells. Emission strength is set in the engine; the map holds colour only. Output sizes that are not a whole multiple of art_pixels give art pixels of unequal widths. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate posterized to eighths.
technique_references: Worley cells with border distance in art pixels
Island plates from the distance to the cell seed
Ordered dithering with a 4 x 4 Bayer matrix for the rim glow
Neighbour tests for lit and shadowed plate edges
